Usage limits

Projects are limited to 100 per workspace on all paid plans, subject to fair use.

The API is rate limited to 60 requests per minute.

Custom domains are available on the Business plan and above.

Your free trial lasts 30 days. Payment details are required to start a trial.

Legacy Growth plan customers keep their existing allowances.

Usage above your included allowance is charged at $0.01 per additional API call.
